## Decision-quality problem

What user or product decision is unreliable today?

## Proposed change

Describe the smallest reusable change and why it belongs in the skill.

## Evidence or failing example

Link a public repository, commit-pinned source, fixture, or before/after artifact. Separate verified facts, inferences, unknowns, and conflicts.

## Validation

- [ ] I ran the relevant validators.
- [ ] I checked changed HTML or SVG artifacts visually when applicable.
- [ ] I did not include credentials, private repository content, personal data, or unrelated local files.
- [ ] I documented compatibility, migration, or report-contract changes.

## Decision impact

Which conclusion, gate, recommendation, or user workflow becomes more reliable because of this change?
